summary: 2026 FSTEC Restaurant Technology Guide. The guide identifies the following participating restaurant-technology vendors across point-of-sale, customer experience, back-of-house technology, loyalty and marketing, online ordering, and data and cybersecurity categories: PAR Technology; Oracle Food & Beverage; Qu; Genius for Restaurants; NCR Voyix; Swipe Savvy POS; Iconex; IW; Kluck; Square; StickyPOS;
NCR Voyix, headquartered in Atlanta, GA, is led by President and CEO James G. Kelly, who was elevated to CEO in February 2025 and previously served as CEO of payments company EVO Payments.

As of a December 15, 2025 company press release, NCR Voyix states it is the world's largest supplier of POS software, #1 in total retail POS installations worldwide, and reclaimed the top position for new restaurant POS deployments; it serves customers across 35 countries and cites an anticipated 2.3 million new POS software installations globally through 2030. (Scope note: Market-leadership and installation figures are company-reported claims in its own press release, not independently audited third-party market-share data.)

CEO James Kelly stated he personally met with the CEOs of 72 of NCR Voyix's restaurant customers over a six-month period, part of the company's platform-led strategy emphasizing scalable, resilient enterprise solutions. (Scope note: No specific restaurant brand names were disclosed among the 72 customer-CEO meetings referenced.)
